name: number-picker-card
author: Dwaine Gallimore
description: Lovelace number-picker-card - a dependency-free, fluid scroll-wheel number picker for input_number entities

scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && node build.mjs
scripts.release-patch: npm version patch && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release-minor: npm version minor && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release-major: npm version major && git push origin main --tags
